arg.name: centerline_topic
arg.description: Map-frame, accumulating shoulder centerline path (nav_msgs/Path) published by shoulder_centerline_node in shoulder_detection_ws

arg.name: objects_topic
arg.description: autoware_perception_msgs/PredictedObjects, used for the trajectory planner's collision check

arg.name: require_autonomous_mode
arg.description: Refuse to trigger unless /api/operation_mode/state reports AUTONOMOUS -- prevents planning a maneuver while the vehicle is not under Autoware's driving control

arg.name: keyboard_trigger_enabled
arg.description: Simulated MRM trigger for development: press this key in the node's launch terminal. Only active if stdin is a TTY. The real trigger path (tier4_system_msgs/srv/OperateMrm on /system/mrm/pull_over_manager/operate) is always active regardless of this flag -- this is purely an additional, convenient stand-in until a real diagnostics-driven MRM condition is wired up.

arg.name: poll_rate_hz
arg.description: Rate at which the keyboard-trigger flag is drained on the executor thread

arg.name: planning_rate_hz
arg.description: Receding-horizon replanning rate while a maneuver is in progress

arg.name: arrival_distance_threshold
arg.description: Meters from goal to declare the maneuver succeeded

arg.name: arrival_speed_threshold
arg.description: m/s below which ego is considered stopped for arrival purposes

arg.name: max_consecutive_planning_failures
arg.description: Consecutive cycles with no feasible/collision-free trajectory before giving up and reporting failure

arg.name: direct_trajectory_output_topic
arg.description: DANGER if misused: when non-empty, this node ALSO publishes its planned trajectory directly on this topic name every planning cycle while operating. Only set this to the live control-facing trajectory topic (e.g. /planning/trajectory) if planning_validator's own output has been remapped away from that name first -- otherwise two publishers race on the same topic while the vehicle may be under autonomous control. Leave empty (default) to only publish on this node's own debug topics.

arg.name: trajectory_max_curvature
arg.description: 1/m -- conservative vs. planning_validator's own ~1.0 hard limit

arg.name: trajectory_max_lateral_accel
arg.description: m/s^2 -- conservative vs. planning_validator's 9.8 hard limit

arg.name: trajectory_max_lateral_jerk
arg.description: m/s^3 -- conservative vs. planning_validator's 7.0 hard limit

arg.name: trajectory_ego_footprint_radius
arg.description: Circular over-approximation of the ego footprint (m) for collision checking

arg.name: visualization_width
arg.description: Width (m) of the shaded RViz ribbon published on ~/planned_path_marker -- roughly lane-width by default
